name: grok-build-bridge
description: Delegate bounded reviews, critiques, and explicitly authorized edits from Codex to the local Grok Build CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Give bounded work to the local Grok agent.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the installed Grok Build CLI through an isolated home and strict sandbox for private-prompt reviews, critiques, and explicitly authorized edits. Background runs keep bounded local receipts and can be inspected or stopped.
defaultPrompt: Ask Grok to review this repository without changing it.
Have Grok challenge this implementation plan.
Check whether the local Grok bridge is ready.
